patterns.note: The page utilizes a highly minimal, centered layout with significant whitespace, focusing all attention on the age verification prompt.

A limited, warm color palette consisting of a cream background, dark brown/black text, and a single vibrant orange accent color for primary calls to action.
No scroll-triggered motion is observed on this age-gate page; the content remains static and centered across all provided scroll depths.
